issue: Money amounts are rounded wrong. All amounts must round half-up to whole cents: discount(10.05, 50) returns 5.02 but should be 5.03, and add_tax(2.5, 5) returns 2.62 but should be 2.63.
prompt_template:
Bug report for the project in {workdir}:

Money amounts are rounded wrong. All amounts must round half-up to whole cents: discount(10.05, 50) returns 5.02 but should be 5.03, and add_tax(2.5, 5) returns 2.62 but should be 2.63.

Fix the bug in the source code (not the tests). Run the tests with `pytest -q` (the full suite takes about 30 seconds). When you're done, reply with a short summary of what you changed and whether the tests pass.
